_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.0 (part 7): alternating hint lines, rumors, field notes and weather forecasts.
Read by tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_hints.py, which writes src/data/hoenn_hints.h (the tables
src/hoenn_hints.c reads), data/scripts/hoenn_hints.inc (one wrapper script per NPC, plus every
text) and swaps each listed NPC's script in its map.json for the wrapper. Re-runs are idempotent.
lines: reusable extra lines. kind is tip / story / rumor / forecast (documentation only, except
that rumor lines name a rumor and forecast lines show today's or tomorrow's forecast). 'if' is a
list of conditions that must all hold. Texts are word-wrapped by the generator; a list of strings
is one text box per string.
rumors: 'found' says when the player has found it (all conditions hold); NPCs then say 'after'
instead of 'before'. The field-notes researcher counts found rumors and gives the first unfound
rumor's 'notes' as a vague hint. Later parts add their own rumors here (roadmap rule).
npcs: the NPCs that get extra lines. A global toggle (VAR_HOENN_HINT_TOGGLE) flips on every talk
to one of them: one talk runs the NPC's own script, the next their first line whose conditions
hold (or their own script again if none does). always: true skips the toggle (the line, when one
holds, always comes first). 'index' picks the object when several share the script.
forecasts: {map, if, text}. A forecast applies when the map's special-weather day is today or
tomorrow (STR_VAR_1 = TODAY / TOMORROW) and its conditions hold, and only in the region of the
map the player is in. Shown by forecast lines and by every TV (before its normal show). Only
forecast weather that matters: something rare depends on it (2.0-plan section 2f).
Conditions: {flag: F} {not_flag: F} {var: V, min: n} {var: V, below: n} {stamps_min: n}
{stamps_below: n} (Hoenn badges) {badges_min: n} {badges_below: n} (HnS's 16 badges)
{caught: SPECIES} {not_caught: SPECIES} {level_cap: true} (HnS's level cap option is on).

TIP_CLOCK.text: Did you know? The clock on the wall in any POKéMON CENTER lets you set the day and the time.

text: With the LEVEL CAP on, your POKéMON stop growing at the next GYM LEADER's level.
Every BADGE you win raises the cap a little.
Some POKéMON only come out when the weather turns.
Rainy days and stormy days bring out different faces in the grass!

TIP_REMINDER_JK.text: A man in BLACKTHORN CITY can make POKéMON remember moves they've forgotten.

TIP_NAMERATER_JK.text: The NAME RATER in GOLDENROD CITY can give your POKéMON a better nickname.

TIP_REMINDER_H.text: In FALLARBOR TOWN there's a MOVE REMINDER. He helps POKéMON remember forgotten moves.

TIP_NAMERATER_H.text: The NAME RATER in SLATEPORT CITY can change your POKéMON's nicknames.

text: A guru in MOSSDEEP CITY reads POKéMON's minds.
For STAR PIECES, he can bring out a POKéMON's hidden potential.
PROF. OAK is said to give TRAINERS with all 16 BADGES a ticket for the ship to HOENN.
Ships leave from VERMILION's port.

STORY_NORMAN.text: NORMAN of PETALBURG only battles TRAINERS who already have four HOENN BADGES.

text: WATTSON won't battle until someone fixes the generator in NEW MAUVILLE.
He's looking for a TRAINER to help!
The MOSSDEEP GYM twins won't battle until the SPACE CENTER gets its meteorite back.
COZMO in FALLARBOR might know where one is.

STORY_WINONA.text: FORTREE's GYM LEADER WINONA has been out by the WEATHER INSTITUTE on ROUTE 119.

before: They say CASTFORM only show themselves when the weather turns.
Look around ROUTES 119, 120 and 123 when the sky turns!
CASTFORM.after: Somebody caught a CASTFORM! So it really does ride the weather near the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
notes: Something near the WEATHER INSTITUTE changes with the sky…
It only appears when the weather turns.

before: A fisherman swears ROUTE 119's river hides a POKéMON nobody else can find.
Only a few spots in the whole river, he says!
FEEBAS.after: So FEEBAS really lives in ROUTE 119's river! Only a handful of spots, too.
FEEBAS.notes: A shabby fish hides in a long river in HOENN. Only a few spots in it, and they change…

MASQUERAIN.before: In HOENN, MASQUERAIN only flutter out of the grass on rainy days.
MASQUERAIN.after: Somebody caught a MASQUERAIN in the rain! I knew those rainy days were worth it.
MASQUERAIN.notes: A bug with eye-patterned wings only comes out on HOENN's rainy days.

LAPRAS.before: Every Friday, a LAPRAS is said to sing deep down in UNION CAVE.
LAPRAS.after: Somebody met UNION CAVE's Friday LAPRAS! Its song is real after all.
LAPRAS.notes: Deep in a JOHTO cave, a song can be heard once a week. Which day was it…?
